source.title: Clogher Rural District, "Notice of Result of Elections: Election of Rural District Councillors for the above-named Rural District in the Year 1908", dated 28 May 1908, Claude C. Hamilton, returning officer (PRONI LA/24/3/AD/1; the owner's photographs of 10 November 2026, frames 391 and 393); compared with the Tyrone Constitution, 29 May 1908, p. 5 (Clogher Rural District)
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Clogher Rural District Council records)
source.check: read from the owner's photographs of the printed notice in two blind transcriptions by separate readers, which agreed on every name, figure and mark; a script checked that each division elects as many as its seats and that the elected are the top of the poll; abodes are not published

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, held with the election of the board of guardians: each district electoral division returned its councillors, who were also its guardians. Polled Wednesday 27 May 1908 ("Polling took place on Wednesday": Tyrone Constitution, 29 May 1908, p. 5); declared the next day. Clogher returned 2 councillors, with a poll. The Tyrone Constitution (29 May 1908, p. 5) prints Smith 87 (notice 97); the returning officer's notice is followed. 4 candidates for 2 seats.
